description_original:
Please write a function which creates passwords of a desired length, consisting of lowercase characters a to z.

An example of how the function should work:

```python
for i in range(10):
    print(generate_password(8))
```

<sample-output>

lttehepy
olsxttjl
cbjncrzo
dwxqjdgu
gpfdcecs
jabyvgar
xnbbonbl
ktmsjyww
ejhprmel
rjkoacib

</sample-output>
